requirement:
Evidence inputs MAY have a definition form containing exactly `definition` and `text`. `definition` MUST identify one named definition; `text` MUST contain its complete raw fenced declaration as source lines, including its phrase option and explanatory body.

Validation MUST reject missing definitions and changed snapshot text, identifying the definition and showing a compact diff when available. Moving an unchanged definition within its chapter MUST NOT invalidate its snapshot. Evidence displays MUST show the definition name, current source location, and recorded text.
rationale:
I found no gaps. I judged from the provided inputs only and did not run any extra searches.

**Obligations and their code**
- **Form of the input.** A definition input has exactly `definition` and `text`.
  - `validate_input` (src/evidence.rs) calls `check_keys` with `["definition","text"]` and reads both fields. `text_field` requires a nonempty array of lines.
  - `InputSelector::from_input` and `to_input` (src/inputs.rs) parse and record that same shape.
- **`definition` identifies one named definition.** `InputSelector::resolve`, Definition arm (src/inputs.rs), looks the name up in `definitions`. It accepts only the `Term` kind, and otherwise returns "no matching named definition".
- **`text` is the complete raw fenced declaration.** The same arm sets the resolved text to `redact_lines(&target.raw_lines)`. These are the raw declaration lines, so the phrase option and body are included.
- **Reject missing definitions.** `validate_resolved_input` pushes the resolve error with the label and the name, for example "glossary.a: no matching named definition".
- **Reject changed snapshot text, naming the definition and showing a compact diff.** `validate_resolved_input` compares the recorded text with the resolved text. On a difference it emits "input text changed for {selector:?}", which includes the definition name, followed by `compact_diff`.
- **Moving an unchanged definition does not invalidate it.** The snapshot compares only raw lines, not line numbers, so a move leaves it valid.
- **Displays show name, current location and recorded text.**
  - `render_input` (src/index.rs) labels the input "definition {name}".
  - It renders the source ranges, taken from the freshly resolved location in `InputLocation::resolve`.
  - It shows the recorded `text`, redacted, in a code block.

**Tests**
- `changed_definition_snapshots_show_a_compact_diff_and_text_is_required` (tests/definitions.rs) asserts the exact compact diff and names `glossary.a`. It also checks that missing, empty or non-array `text` is rejected.
- `definition_schema_deletion_and_literal_references_are_checked` asserts an unexpected field is rejected. It also asserts that deleting the glossary yields "glossary.a … no matching named definition".
- `cyclic_dependencies_are_required_once_and_changes_require_review` prepends blank lines to the glossary, which moves the definitions, and asserts there are no errors. It also asserts that edits to the phrase or body are rejected.
- `detail_page_shows_recorded_text_locations_and_first_matching_group` (src/index.rs) asserts the definition name, the `md/rules.md:9–13` location and the recorded text appear in that order.
- The `record`, `approve` and `definition` helpers in tests/definitions.rs carry `{test}` references.

All the code that implements this requirement carries `{impl}` references. I found no unspecified behaviour and no unacknowledged gaps.
